scope: App 1.5.5 monitor forward compatibility: evaluate() ignores a check kind it does not know instead of returning report_invalid for all three components, while still requiring both known checks; a report missing certificate or telnet stays report_invalid. Tests assert that an unknown extra key changes no current verdict and that the staleness and clock rules of the known checks are untouched. Status schema, reason codes, report format, state format, capture and normalize are unchanged. This release also adds documentation only: the monitor's three components cannot see a controller that has left the relay's broker; 1x Heizen and 1x Absenken end silently when the firmware returns the circuit to Auto, with no end time derived; the one-time charge trigger's 0 report is its own reset, not completion; and the controller's 60 s/3600 s telemetry cadence is a default a cloud setter can change. No new entity, no acknowledgement write and no countdown were added. Frontend 1.4.14 differs from 1.4.13 only in its version constant and header comment. Rerun and passing on these bytes: 171 synthetic app unit and loopback test methods, 89 tools/monitoring methods, 832 Node checks, 8 package checks and the Playwright browser suites. Recounted from this browser run: 231 assertions, 10 runner negative cases, 5 viewport/theme layout cases with 15 transitions each at 400 px. browser_pointer_gestures and popup_layout_transition_cases were not recounted and are carried over from 1.4.10. Not performed: container build, pinned-image init smoke, HA or Supervisor installation, real notification delivery, independent source review and physical acceptance.
